\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Processors command after simulation box is defined}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The processors command cannot be used after a read\_data, read\_restart,
or create\_box command.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Processors custom grid file is inconsistent}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The vales in the custom file are not consistent with the number of
processors you are running on or the Px,Py,Pz settings of the
processors command.  Or there was not a setting for every processor.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Processors grid numa and map style are incompatible}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Using numa for gstyle in the processors command requires using
cart for the map option.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Processors part option and grid style are incompatible}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Cannot use gstyle numa or custom with the part option.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Processors twogrid requires proc count be a multiple of core count}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Pstart and Pstop must have the same value}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Python function evaluation failed}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The Python function did not run successfully and/or did not return a
value (if it is supposed to return a value).  This is probably due to
some error condition in the function.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Python function is not callable}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The provided Python code was run successfully, but it not
define a callable function with the required name.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Python invoke of undefined function}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Cannot invoke a function that has not been previously defined.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Python variable does not match Python function}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
This matching is defined by the python\sphinxhyphen{}style variable and the python
command.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Python variable has no function}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
No python command was used to define the function associated with the
python\sphinxhyphen{}style variable.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{QEQ with ‘newton pair off’ not supported}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
See the newton command.  This is a restriction to use the QEQ fixes.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{R0 \textless{} 0 for fix spring command}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Equilibrium spring length is invalid.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{RATTLE coordinate constraints are not satisfied up to desired tolerance}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{RATTLE determinant = 0.0}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The determinant of the matrix being solved for a single cluster
specified by the fix rattle command is numerically invalid.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{RATTLE failed}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Certain constraints were not satisfied.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{RATTLE velocity constraints are not satisfied up to desired tolerance}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Read data add offset is too big}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
It cannot be larger than the size of atom IDs, e.g. the maximum 32\sphinxhyphen{}bit
integer.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Read dump of atom property that is not allocated}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Read rerun dump file timestep \textgreater{} specified stop}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Read restart MPI\sphinxhyphen{}IO input not allowed with \% in filename}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
This is because a \% signifies one file per processor and MPI\sphinxhyphen{}IO
creates one large file for all processors.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Read\_data shrink wrap did not assign all atoms correctly}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
This is typically because the box\sphinxhyphen{}size specified in the data file is
large compared to the actual extent of atoms in a shrink\sphinxhyphen{}wrapped
dimension.  When LAMMPS shrink\sphinxhyphen{}wraps the box atoms will be lost if the
processor they are re\sphinxhyphen{}assigned to is too far away.  Choose a box
size closer to the actual extent of the atoms.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Read\_dump command before simulation box is defined}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The read\_dump command cannot be used before a read\_data, read\_restart,
or create\_box command.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Read\_dump field not found in dump file}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Read\_dump triclinic status does not match simulation}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Both the dump snapshot and the current LAMMPS simulation must
be using either an orthogonal or triclinic box.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Read\_dump xyz fields do not have consistent scaling/wrapping}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Reax\_defs.h setting for NATDEF is too small}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Edit the setting in the ReaxFF library and re\sphinxhyphen{}compile the
library and re\sphinxhyphen{}build LAMMPS.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Reax\_defs.h setting for NNEIGHMAXDEF is too small}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Edit the setting in the ReaxFF library and re\sphinxhyphen{}compile the
library and re\sphinxhyphen{}build LAMMPS.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Receiving partition in processors part command is already a receiver}}

Cannot specify a partition to be a receiver twice.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Region ID for compute chunk/atom does not exist}}

Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Region ID for dump custom does not exist}}

Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Region ID for fix deposit does not exist}}

Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Region ID for fix efield does not exist}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Region ID for fix evaporate does not exist}}

Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Region ID for fix gcmc does not exist}}

Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Region ID for fix heat does not exist}}

Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Region ID for fix setforce does not exist}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Region ID for fix wall/region does not exist}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxAtStartPar
Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Region ID in variable formula does not exist}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Region cannot have 0 length rotation vector}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Region for fix oneway does not exist}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Region intersect region ID does not exist}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Region union or intersect cannot be dynamic}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The sub\sphinxhyphen{}regions can be dynamic, but not the combined region.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Region union region ID does not exist}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
One or more of the region IDs specified by the region union command
does not exist.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Replacing a fix, but new style != old style}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
A fix ID can be used a second time, but only if the style matches the
previous fix.  In this case it is assumed you want to reset a fix’s
parameters.  This error may mean you are mistakenly re\sphinxhyphen{}using a fix ID
when you do not intend to.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Replicate command before simulation box is defined}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The replicate command cannot be used before a read\_data, read\_restart,
or create\_box command.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Replicate did not assign all atoms correctly}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Atoms replicated by the replicate command were not assigned correctly
to processors.  This is likely due to some atom coordinates being
outside a non\sphinxhyphen{}periodic simulation box.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Replicated system atom IDs are too big}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
See the setting for tagint in the src/lmptype.h file.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Replicated system is too big}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
See the setting for bigint in the src/lmptype.h file.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Required border comm not yet implemented with Kokkos}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
There are various limitations in the communication options supported
by Kokkos.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Rerun command before simulation box is defined}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The rerun command cannot be used before a read\_data, read\_restart, or
create\_box command.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Rerun dump file does not contain requested snapshot}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Resetting timestep size is not allowed with fix move}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
This is because fix move is moving atoms based on elapsed time.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Respa inner cutoffs are invalid}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The first cutoff must be \textless{}= the second cutoff.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Respa levels must be \textgreater{}= 1}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Respa middle cutoffs are invalid}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The first cutoff must be \textless{}= the second cutoff.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Restart file MPI\sphinxhyphen{}IO output not allowed with \% in filename}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
This is because a \% signifies one file per processor and MPI\sphinxhyphen{}IO
creates one large file for all processors.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Restart file byte ordering is not recognized}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The file does not appear to be a LAMMPS restart file since it does not
contain a recognized byte\sphinxhyphen{}ordering flag at the beginning.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Restart file byte ordering is swapped}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The file was written on a machine with different byte\sphinxhyphen{}ordering than
the machine you are reading it on.  Convert it to a text data file
instead, on the machine you wrote it on.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Restart file incompatible with current version}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
This is probably because you are trying to read a file created with a
version of LAMMPS that is too old compared to the current version.
Use your older version of LAMMPS and convert the restart file
to a data file.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Restart file is a MPI\sphinxhyphen{}IO file}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The file is inconsistent with the filename you specified for it.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Restart file is a multi\sphinxhyphen{}proc file}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The file is inconsistent with the filename you specified for it.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Restart file is not a MPI\sphinxhyphen{}IO file}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The file is inconsistent with the filename you specified for it.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Restart file is not a multi\sphinxhyphen{}proc file}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The file is inconsistent with the filename you specified for it.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Restart variable returned a bad timestep}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The variable must return a timestep greater than the current timestep.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Restrain atoms \%d \%d \%d \%d missing on proc \%d at step \%ld}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The 4 atoms in a restrain dihedral specified by the fix restrain
command are not all accessible to a processor.  This probably means an
atom has moved too far.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Restrain atoms \%d \%d \%d missing on proc \%d at step \%ld}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The three atoms in a restrain angle specified by the fix restrain
command are not all accessible to a processor.  This probably means an
atom has moved too far.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Restrain atoms \%d \%d missing on proc \%d at step \%ld}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The two atoms in a restrain bond specified by the fix restrain
command are not all accessible to a processor.  This probably means an
atom has moved too far.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Reuse of compute ID}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
A compute ID cannot be used twice.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Reuse of dump ID}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
A dump ID cannot be used twice.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Reuse of molecule template ID}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The template IDs must be unique.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Reuse of region ID}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
A region ID cannot be used twice.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Rigid body atoms \%d \%d missing on proc \%d at step \%ld}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
This means that an atom cannot find the atom that owns the rigid body
it is part of, or vice versa.  The solution is to use the communicate
cutoff command to ensure ghost atoms are acquired from far enough away
to encompass the max distance printed when the fix rigid/small command
was invoked.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Rigid body has degenerate moment of inertia}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Fix poems will only work with bodies (collections of atoms) that have
non\sphinxhyphen{}zero principal moments of inertia.  This means they must be 3 or
more non\sphinxhyphen{}collinear atoms, even with joint atoms removed.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Rigid fix must come before NPT/NPH fix}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
NPT/NPH fix must be defined in input script after all rigid fixes,
else the rigid fix contribution to the pressure virial is
incorrect.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Rmask function in equal\sphinxhyphen{}style variable formula}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Rmask is per\sphinxhyphen{}atom operation.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Run command before simulation box is defined}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The run command cannot be used before a read\_data, read\_restart, or
create\_box command.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Run command start value is after start of run}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Run command stop value is before end of run}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Run\_style command before simulation box is defined}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The run\_style command cannot be used before a read\_data,
read\_restart, or create\_box command.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{SRD bin size for fix srd differs from user request}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Fix SRD had to adjust the bin size to fit the simulation box.  See the
cubic keyword if you want this message to be an error vs warning.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{SRD bins for fix srd are not cubic enough}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The bin shape is not within tolerance of cubic.  See the cubic
keyword if you want this message to be an error vs warning.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{SRD particle \%d started inside big particle \%d on step \%ld bounce \%d}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
See the inside keyword if you want this message to be an error vs
warning.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{SRD particle \%d started inside wall \%d on step \%ld bounce \%d}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
See the inside keyword if you want this message to be an error vs
warning.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Same dimension twice in fix ave/spatial}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Sending partition in processors part command is already a sender}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Cannot specify a partition to be a sender twice.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Set command before simulation box is defined}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The set command cannot be used before a read\_data, read\_restart,
or create\_box command.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Set command floating point vector does not exist}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Set command integer vector does not exist}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Set command with no atoms existing}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
No atoms are yet defined so the set command cannot be used.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Set region ID does not exist}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Region ID specified in set command does not exist.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Shake angles have different bond types}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
All 3\sphinxhyphen{}atom angle\sphinxhyphen{}constrained SHAKE clusters specified by the fix shake
command that are the same angle type, must also have the same bond
types for the two bonds in the angle.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Shake atoms \%d \%d \%d \%d missing on proc \%d at step \%ld}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The 4 atoms in a single shake cluster specified by the fix shake
command are not all accessible to a processor.  This probably means
an atom has moved too far.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Shake atoms \%d \%d \%d missing on proc \%d at step \%ld}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The three atoms in a single shake cluster specified by the fix shake
command are not all accessible to a processor.  This probably means
an atom has moved too far.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Shake atoms \%d \%d missing on proc \%d at step \%ld}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The two atoms in a single shake cluster specified by the fix shake
command are not all accessible to a processor.  This probably means
an atom has moved too far.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Shake cluster of more than 4 atoms}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
A single cluster specified by the fix shake command can have no more
than 4 atoms.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Shake clusters are connected}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
A single cluster specified by the fix shake command must have a single
central atom with up to 3 other atoms bonded to it.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Shake determinant = 0.0}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The determinant of the matrix being solved for a single cluster
specified by the fix shake command is numerically invalid.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Shake fix must come before NPT/NPH fix}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
NPT fix must be defined in input script after SHAKE fix, else the
SHAKE fix contribution to the pressure virial is incorrect.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Shear history overflow, boost neigh\_modify one}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
There are too many neighbors of a single atom.  Use the neigh\_modify
command to increase the max number of neighbors allowed for one atom.
You may also want to boost the page size.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Small to big integers are not sized correctly}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
This error occurs when the sizes of smallint, imageint, tagint, bigint,
as defined in src/lmptype.h are not what is expected.  Contact
the developers if this occurs.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Smallint setting in lmptype.h is invalid}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
It has to be the size of an integer.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Smallint setting in lmptype.h is not compatible}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Smallint stored in restart file is not consistent with LAMMPS version
you are running.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Special list size exceeded in fix bond/create}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
See the “read\_data extra/special/per/atom” command
(or the “create\_box extra/special/per/atom” command)
for info on how to leave space in the special bonds
list to allow for additional bonds to be formed.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Species XXX is not supported by this KIM Simulator Model}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The kim\_style define command was referencing a species that is not
present in the requested KIM Simulator Model.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Specified processors != physical processors}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The 3d grid of processors defined by the processors command does not
match the number of processors LAMMPS is being run on.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Specified target stress must be uniaxial or hydrostatic}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Sqrt of negative value in variable formula}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Subsequent read data induced too many angles per atom}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
See the extra/angle/per/atom keyword for the create\_box
or the read\_data command to set this limit larger

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Subsequent read data induced too many bonds per atom}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
See the extra/bond/per/atom keyword for the create\_box
or the read\_data command to set this limit larger

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Subsequent read data induced too many dihedrals per atom}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
See the extra/dihedral/per/atom keyword for the create\_box
or the read\_data command to set this limit larger

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Subsequent read data induced too many impropers per atom}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
See the extra/improper/per/atom keyword for the create\_box
or the read\_data command to set this limit larger

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Substitution for illegal variable}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Input script line contained a variable that could not be substituted
for.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Support for writing images in JPEG format not included}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
LAMMPS was not built with the \sphinxhyphen{}DLAMMPS\_JPEG switch in the Makefile.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Support for writing images in PNG format not included}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
LAMMPS was not built with the \sphinxhyphen{}DLAMMPS\_PNG switch in the Makefile.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Support for writing movies not included}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
LAMMPS was not built with the \sphinxhyphen{}DLAMMPS\_FFMPEG switch in the Makefile

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{System in data file is too big}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
See the setting for bigint in the src/lmptype.h file.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{System is not charge neutral, net charge = \%g}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The total charge on all atoms on the system is not 0.0.
For some KSpace solvers this is an error.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{TAD nsteps must be multiple of t\_event}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{TIP4P hydrogen has incorrect atom type}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The TIP4P pairwise computation found an H atom whose type does not
agree with the specified H type.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{TIP4P hydrogen is missing}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The TIP4P pairwise computation failed to find the correct H atom
within a water molecule.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{TMD target file did not list all group atoms}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The target file for the fix tmd command did not list all atoms in the
fix group.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Tad command before simulation box is defined}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Tagint setting in lmptype.h is invalid}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Tagint must be as large or larger than smallint.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Tagint setting in lmptype.h is not compatible}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Format of tagint stored in restart file is not consistent with LAMMPS
version you are running.  See the settings in src/lmptype.h

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Target pressure for fix rigid/nph cannot be \textless{} 0.0}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Target pressure for fix rigid/npt/small cannot be \textless{} 0.0}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Target temperature for fix nvt/npt/nph cannot be 0.0}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Target temperature for fix rigid/npt cannot be 0.0}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Self\sphinxhyphen{}explanatory.

\sphinxlineitem{\sphinxstyleemphasis{Target temperature for fix rigid/npt/small cannot be 0.0}}
